budget_categories.name: Venue & Space Rental
budget_categories.rationale: Party room, backyard tent, or event hall reservation fees.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Host at a community park or residential clubhouse with low reservation costs.

budget_categories.name: Food & Beverage
budget_categories.rationale: Catering platters, snacks, beverages, and specialty birthday cake.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Schedule party between 14:00 and 17:00 to serve appetizers and cake rather than full meals.

budget_categories.name: Entertainment & Activities
budget_categories.rationale: Live performer, DJ, game host, photo booth, or activity instructor.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Hire a student entertainer or organize DIY interactive group games with prizes.

budget_categories.name: Decorations & Theme Props
budget_categories.rationale: Balloons, thematic banners, tableware, photo backdrop, and lighting.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Focus on one high-impact focal photo wall rather than scattering decor everywhere.

budget_categories.name: Party Favors & Keepsakes
budget_categories.rationale: Themed take-home gifts and custom souvenir treat boxes.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Provide edible favors such as custom cookies that guests genuinely enjoy.

milestones.title: Select Birthday Theme & Date
milestones.notes: Align theme with honoree interests and confirm guest of honor availability.

milestones.title: Reserve Party Space
milestones.notes: Verify rules on outside food and decor setup windows.

milestones.title: Book Entertainment & Order Custom Cake
milestones.notes: Confirm entertainer arrival time and cake flavor/design specifications.

milestones.title: Send Invitations & Collect RSVPs
milestones.notes: Note dietary questions and RSVP deadline 7 days prior.

milestones.title: Assemble Party Decor & Goodie Bags
milestones.notes: Verify counts against confirmed RSVP list.

run_of_show.notes: Inflate balloons, test music sound system, lay out tableware.
Greet guests, collect gifts, invite to welcome snack bar.
Lead party games or performance session.
Gather all guests around the cake for photos.
Distribute cake slices and encourage photo station visits.
Hand personalized favor bags to departing guests.

vendor_categories.title: Party Venue / Event Space
questions_to_ask: How much setup and teardown buffer time is granted before and after the event?
Are open flame candles permitted on birthday cakes?
Is there on-site parking for families with children or strollers?
documents_to_verify: Venue rules sheet including cleanup responsibilities
red_flags: Unrealistic setup windows (less than 30 minutes for party prep)
Severe restrictions that prohibit cake candles or basic balloons

vendor_categories.title: Party Performer or Game Facilitator
questions_to_ask: What age range is your performance or activity program optimized for?
Do you supply your own sound equipment, microphones, and activity props?
How do you handle shy children or restless guests during the program?
documents_to_verify: Performance contract specifying start/end times and gear requirements
red_flags: No verified references or video clips of recent performances
Refusal to commit to a written schedule

vendor_categories.title: Custom Cake & Confectionery Baker
questions_to_ask: Do you offer nut-free, gluten-free, or vegan cake tiers?
Do you deliver and assemble the cake directly at the venue?
What refrigeration is required before cutting?
documents_to_verify: Design sketch or photo reference approval sign-off
red_flags: Requires customer transport of complex multi-tier cakes without packaging
